features.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about our vehicle history reports.

faq.q: What is a vehicle history report?
faq.a: A vehicle history report is a comprehensive document that compiles data from thousands of sources to reveal a vehicle's complete past — including mileage records, damage history, theft status, inspection results, emissions data, and natural disaster exposure.

faq.q: How quickly is the report generated?
faq.a: Reports are typically generated in under 60 seconds. Our platform queries 8,000+ data sources in real time and compiles the results into a structured, easy-to-read report.

faq.q: Which countries are covered?
faq.a: We currently cover 25+ countries across Europe, with data from government registries, insurance databases, auction platforms, and authorized service centers in each jurisdiction.

faq.q: Can I check a vehicle using just the license plate?
faq.a: Yes. You can search using either the VIN (Vehicle Identification Number) or the license plate number. Both methods provide the same comprehensive report.

faq.q: What is the Autocertif Score?
faq.a: The Autocertif Score is a proprietary rating from 1 to 10 that summarizes the overall condition and risk profile of a vehicle based on all data points in the report. A higher score indicates fewer issues detected.

faq.q: How accurate is the mileage verification?
faq.a: Our mileage verification cross-references odometer readings from multiple independent sources including service records, inspection results, and insurance data. We flag any inconsistencies or suspicious patterns in the mileage progression.

faq.q: Is my data secure?
faq.a: Absolutely. All data transmissions are encrypted with TLS 1.3, and we comply with GDPR regulations. We do not store personal search data beyond what is necessary to deliver your report.

faq.q: How does Autocertif work?
faq.a: Autocertif cross-references 2,500+ checkpoints from 8,000+ sources across 25+ countries. Simply enter a VIN number or license plate, and we generate a comprehensive vehicle history report in ~55 seconds on average. The report includes mileage verification, accident history, theft records, vehicle inspection, emissions data, and more.

faq.q: What is a VIN and where can I find it?
faq.a: A VIN (Vehicle Identification Number) is a unique 17-character code assigned to every vehicle. You can find it on the driver's side dashboard (visible through the windshield), on the driver's side door jamb sticker, on the vehicle registration document, or on the insurance card. It contains no letters I, O, or Q to avoid confusion with numbers.

faq.q: How long does it take to receive my report?
faq.a: Most reports are generated in ~55 seconds on average. In rare cases where data from certain sources takes longer to compile, it may take up to a few minutes. You'll receive an email notification as soon as your report is ready.

faq.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. For business clients purchasing bulk packages, we also offer bank transfer as a payment option.

faq.q: Can I get a refund if I'm not satisfied?
faq.a: If your report contains incomplete or inaccurate data, you can contact our support team with your order number and a description of the issue. Refund eligibility is assessed on a case-by-case basis. Please review our Refund Policy for full details.

faq.q: What countries does Autocertif cover?
faq.a: Autocertif covers vehicles registered in over 25 countries, with particularly strong coverage across the European Union and the United Kingdom. Data availability may vary by country depending on local registries and data sources.

faq.q: How accurate is the mileage verification?
faq.a: Our mileage verification cross-references data from official vehicle inspections, service records, insurance databases, and other verified sources. We flag any discrepancies or suspicious rollbacks. While no system is 100% infallible, our multi-source approach provides one of the most reliable mileage checks available on the market.

faq.q: Do you offer solutions for businesses?
faq.a: Yes! We offer tailored solutions for car dealerships, insurance companies, leasing firms, and other automotive businesses. This includes bulk report packages, API integration for your existing systems, dedicated account management, and custom pricing. Visit our Business page or contact our sales team for more information.

The version currently published on the Site is the effective version. The Company reserves the right to modify this policy to comply with privacy protection laws.

Key definitions (GDPR Art. 4): "Consent" means any freely given, specific, informed and unambiguous indication of the data subject's wishes by which he or she signifies agreement to the processing of personal data. "Data Controller" means the natural or legal person which determines the purposes and means of the processing. "Processor" means a natural or legal person which processes personal data on behalf of the controller. "Processing" means any operation performed on personal data, such as collection, recording, storage, retrieval, use, disclosure, or destruction. "Personal data breach" means a breach of security leading to the accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, or unauthorised disclosure of personal data.

Other terms: "Subscription" refers to the Subscription taken out by the Client to access LADEV LTD. services. "Client" refers to the contracting party who has subscribed to the services. "Services" refers to the Services provided by the Data Controller. "Website" refers to autocertif.com. "User" refers to any individual using the Website.

sections.title: Personal Data & Minors
sections.content:
Personal data ("Personal Data") refers to any information that can directly or indirectly identify a natural person (surname, first name, email, telephone number, postal address, etc.). Under the GDPR, this means "any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person; an identifiable natural person is one who can be identified, directly or indirectly, in particular by reference to an identifier such as a name, an identification number, location data, an online identifier or to one or more factors specific to the physical, physiological, genetic, mental, economic, cultural or social identity of that natural person."

Only minors aged 15 or over may consent to the processing of their personal data (Article 8 of European Regulation 2016/679). Users under 15 must obtain consent of a legal representative.

User consent is collected prior to any data processing. Data is processed strictly for the purposes detailed in this Policy.

contact.faqSubtitle: You might find your answer here.

faq.q: How do I get a refund?
faq.a: If you experience an issue with your report, reach out through our contact page. Please review our Refund Policy for details.

faq.q: My report seems incomplete. What should I do?
faq.a: Data availability varies by country and vehicle. If you believe something is missing, contact us with your order number and we'll investigate.

faq.q: Can I check a vehicle from another country?
faq.a: Yes! Autocertif covers 25+ countries. A single report includes all available data across borders. No extra fees.

faq.q: How quickly will I receive my report?
faq.a: Reports are generated in ~55 seconds on average. Once purchased, you'll have instant access to view online or download as a PDF.

faq.q: Do you offer solutions for businesses?
faq.a: Absolutely. We provide API access, white-label solutions, and volume pricing for dealerships, insurers, and marketplaces.

faq.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.
